shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git ls-files && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50
cat src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls components/theme; cat components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts components/theme/ThemeProvider.js components/theme/types.d.ts components/theme/index.d.ts; ls components/theme/*/ 2>/dev/null; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts

grep -rn "deprecated" components/theme components/Switch components/Portal components/SegmentedRadioGroup 2>/dev/null | head; cat components/theme/useTheme.d.ts components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts; cat components/types.d.ts | sed -n '1,60p'; cat components/Portal/Portal.js | head -40; ls components | tr '\n' ' '
grep -n "gap\|direction\|alignItems" components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; grep -n "variant\|color" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "view\|type" components/Card/Card.d.ts | head
